author: Forbes
description:
Recently named the #1 Innovator on the Forbes Innovators 250 list, Elon Musk sits down with Forbes' Randall Lane for a wide-ranging conversation on the future of humanity and technology. In this interview, Musk shares his candid thoughts on the recent OpenAI lawsuit and the ethics of non-profit to for-profit conversions. He also dives deep into his ultimate goals for SpaceX and Neuralink, predicts a timeline for AI surpassing human intelligence, and explains why the future of AI computing power belongs in space. Finally, Musk reveals the untapped industries he believes are ripe for disruption, including synthetic medicine and electric aircraft.
